svg.title: Enterprise Agent Factory operating model and governed flow
svg.desc: Conceptual architecture showing enterprise governance, people and ownership, an Agent Factory control plane, and repeatable isolated Workstream cells connected by software delivery, inference, tool, telemetry, and governance flows.
svg.text: Enterprise Agent Factory — governed self-service at scale
One enterprise control plane · repeatable isolated Workstream cells · hundreds of engineers and many agentic use cases
Preventive controls and shared assurance applied across Platform and every Workstream cell
Built and operated once per supported Platform environment; consumed through versioned interfaces, not deployment tickets
Workstream fleet — repeatable isolated cells (1 … N)
Scale horizontally by product, domain, regulatory boundary or portfolio; each cell retains independent release and failure boundaries
Same versioned baseline and release contract
Scale unit: repeatable Workstream cell · delegated ownership · account-level isolation · central policy · fleet visibility · chargeback
Platform owns standards, compatibility and shared services · product teams own agents, tools, data and outcomes
Logical reference architecture · official AWS Architecture Icons · replicate Regions only after independent validation
